name: Off the Scale
description: Cards beyond the numbers. Two Backflip Bats (-1) turn the round upside down and back, so the lowest card wins. The Galaxy Goldfish (∞) beats every number and calls last call: one more turn for everyone else, then the showdown. House design, balance untested.

add.name: Backflip Bat
add.text: When this card is put face up in front of anyone, the round turns upside down (the lowest card wins the showdown), or back again. If you played it, everyone sees the card you keep.

then.text: The round turns upside down! The lowest card wins the showdown.

else.text: The round flips back. The highest card wins the showdown again.

add.name: Galaxy Goldfish
add.text: Higher than any number. If you play it, it is last call: everyone else takes one more turn, then the showdown happens instead of your next turn. If you are knocked out first, there is no early showdown.

onPlay.text: Last call! Everyone else takes one more turn, then the showdown.

upsideDown.label: Upside down
upsideDown.text: The lowest card wins the showdown.
